facts.fact: The Standard reports that the National Assembly approved the Communications Bill 2025 at second reading (the day before the 2026-03-03 publication), after a first reading on 19 November 2025, and sent it to the ABC Committee; the Minister said it will create a legal framework for electronic transactions, recognising electronic signatures and contracts, and covers electronic commerce services.
